changes.title: Lighter statistics aggregates
changes.text: Statistics calculations allocate distinct-value and median containers only when those calculations need them.

changes.title: Resumed-run import regression
changes.text: Added a real-log and cache-reload check that an unfinished resumed run does not hide an imported finished ranking.

changes.title: Allocation measurement
changes.text: Added a repeatable desktop measurement of statistics aggregate allocations without changing Android gameplay.

changes.title: Verification and delivery evidence
changes.text: Recorded TEST73 signing checks, private APK delivery and the ongoing statistics audit.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I reduced unnecessary statistics allocations while preserving query results. I also added a saved-history regression for resumed runs.
